shared_elements: human figure with head shown in relief
representation of a human head with stylized hair/headdress
carved low-relief motifs on a stone surface
curvilinear/spiral-like motifs (ram horn vs. carved circles/rings)
justification: Both depict a human figure and use low-relief carving, but A shows a naturalistic bearded man in profile leading two horned rams with finely striated fleece and detailed eyes and horns, while B shows a massive frontal/rear-view schematic figure whose surface bears abstract ring, crescent and band motifs with no animals at all. The only correspondence is the generic presence of a human form and some curved/circular motifs, which any tradition could produce independently; the rendering conventions (detailed profile naturalism vs. blocky abstraction) differ completely.
